items.headline: Parents petition for road repairs
items.text: East Bengaluru parents launched a petition seeking road repairs and traffic measures, citing "2 hours for 2 km", reports Moneycontrol.

items.headline: Airport marks Dasara with heritage displays
items.text: Bengaluru airport showcases Karnataka's art and heritage through performances, installations and interactives for Dasara 2026, reports The Hindu.

items.headline: Assetz Twin Lake City eyes Hennur–Horamavu
items.text: The Tribune reports on Assetz Twin Lake City and buyer interest in the Hennur–Horamavu corridor.

items.headline: Old Mysuru Road bridge holds up traffic
items.text: A narrow, 60-year-old bridge on Mysuru Road holds up traffic and raises safety concerns, reports Deccan Herald.

development_stories.headline: Sadahalli underpass planned on airport road
development_stories.text: Urban Acres reports a ₹35 Crore underpass project at Sadahalli on the Bengaluru airport road.

development_stories.headline: GBA approves felling 321 trees at Hoodi
development_stories.text: The GBA approved felling of 321 trees for a KPTCL project, reports Deccan Herald. Asianet Newsable says the trees are at Hoodi Substation, for a transmission upgrade.

development_stories.headline: Waste and encroachments threaten city lake
development_stories.text: Waste and encroachments continue to threaten Yele Mallappa Chetty Lake, reports Deccan Herald.

development_stories.headline: Hilton signs two airport hotels with Kalyani
development_stories.text: Hilton signed two Bengaluru airport hotels with Kalyani Group, adding 600 rooms, reports ET TravelWorld.

development_stories.headline: Hotel brand debut and office lease
development_stories.text: The Jerusalem Post reports Dan Hotels' Bengaluru property joins Hilton's LXR brand in its India debut. Hindustan Times reports a Blackstone arm leased 4.5 lakh sq ft of office space for five years.

front_briefs.headline: Hebbal tunnel road draws finance questions
front_briefs.text: The New Indian Express reports the Karnataka Finance Department flagged concerns over the Hebbal short tunnel road. Urban Acres reports the tunnel road faces environmental questions.

front_briefs.headline: GBA opens road network maps for objections
front_briefs.text: The GBA has invited suggestions and objections on road network maps, with 60 days allowed, reports NammaWard. Deccan Herald says the maps were unavailable online.

front_briefs.headline: Kaveri 2.0 failure delays property services
front_briefs.text: FM Bharat reports property owners face delays after a Kaveri 2.0 software failure hit GBA services; The Siasat Daily says registration was disrupted across the GBA area.

front_briefs.headline: Karanth Layout deadline extended
front_briefs.text: BDA extended the Shivaram Karanth Layout site application deadline to 31 October noon, reports NammaWard.

government_stories.headline: BDA extends Karanth Layout applications
government_stories.text: BDA extended the Shivaram Karanth Layout application deadline to 31 October, reports Deccan Herald. The New Indian Express reports domicile certificate delays are holding up applications; Asianet Newsable reported a 15-day extension was proposed amid low applications.

government_stories.headline: High Court warns BDA, backs attachment
government_stories.text: The Times of India reports the Karnataka high court warned the BDA against violating guidelines while upholding land acquisition. LiveLawBiz reports it upheld Unishire property attachment; scanx.trade says Embassy retains 78 acres after a KIADB order was set aside.

government_stories.headline: RERA rulings target builders' cost pass-through
government_stories.text: Prop News Time reports Karnataka RERA bars builders from passing project costs to homebuyers. Deccan Herald reports RERA ordered a villa developer to fix defects within 90 days. LiveLawBiz reports REAT upheld an order for a homebuyer to pay ₹2.45 Lakh.

government_stories.headline: Apartment owners await governor's assent
government_stories.text: Apartment owners are awaiting the governor's assent to a new law on ownership and common areas, report The Times of India and Prop News Time. Urban Acres reports the Karnataka apartment law is pending assent.

government_stories.headline: BDA offers reward on encroachment tips
government_stories.text: BDA offers up to Rs 4 lakh for information on encroached properties, reports Deccan Herald. The Hindu's talk series features N.A. Haris on the BDA's vision for Bengaluru.

government_stories.headline: GBA explores AI digital twin for civic planning
government_stories.text: The GBA is exploring AI-powered digital twin technology for civic planning, report Inshorts and Asianet Newsable. ORF assesses a year of the Greater Bengaluru Authority as fragmented still.

investment_column.headline: Reading Bengaluru's growth areas by stage

paragraphs.text: Bidadi's township and AI city is approved, with the GBDA as executing agency. The BMRDA's proposed integrated townships name Bidadi as pilot, and PropNewz reports industrial township land. Buyers might check approvals, title and water before treating approval as delivery.

Q-City at Hesaraghatta has land sanctioned. SWIFT City, planned across 1,000 acres with 150 ft roads, and KWIN City, over 5,800 acres with a planned monorail, are only announced. Announced projects carry execution risk worth weighing.

Karnataka dropped acquisition at the Devanahalli aerospace park and the plan was reported scrapped. Harohalli is the leading contender for a second airport but remains proposed. The Bengaluru Business Corridor is awarded, while the Dobbaspet logistics hub's stage is unclear.

Near the city, Puravankara's Sathanur deal and the Karanth Layout show interest is following concrete steps. Even so, the Hebbal tunnel road's flagged concerns are a reminder to check funding before relying on a driver. These are considerations, not advice.

launches.headline: Brigade Gunjur pre-launch
launches.text: Brigade Enterprises lists Brigade Gunjur at pre-launch stage: 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes, about 2,500 in all, in a 39-acre township.

launches.headline: Century launches The Astoria in Jakkur
launches.text: Century Real Estate launched The Astoria at Century Immencity: 334 homes of 3 and 4 BHK plus penthouses, per the developer's release.

launches.headline: Puravankara plans Sathanur project on JDA land
launches.text: Puravankara signed a joint development agreement for a Sathanur parcel with an estimated GDV of ₹2,500 crore; the project is about 1.90 million sq ft saleable.

lead.headline: GBA chief orders junction plan for Bannerghatta Road

paragraphs.text: GBA Chief Commissioner M Maheshwar Rao directed officials to prepare a DPR for junctions between Gottigere and Tavarekere on Bannerghatta Road, according to The Bengaluru Live. The direction followed his inspection of the road's footpaths around 13 October. The paper notes it is a direction, not completed works.

The inspection found pedestrians lacked a safe pathway near Kalena Agrahara metro station, The Bengaluru Live reported. Rao ordered missing drain slabs replaced and mid-block median crossings built where needed.

The plan drew wide coverage. The Hindu and Deccan Herald report the GBA will prepare the DPR, NewsFirst Prime reports junction upgrades and safer footpaths are planned, and The New Indian Express reports the junctions are to be developed for smoother traffic movement.

lead.standfirst: After inspecting footpaths, Chief Commissioner M Maheshwar Rao directed officials to prepare a detailed project report for junctions between Gottigere and Tavarekere.

metro_intro.text: Pink Line safety clearance dominates the metro page, while BMRCL begins soil work for a proposed Red Line corridor, the Purple Line suffers a disruption and suburban rail plans advance.

metro_stories.headline: Pink Line faces 36 safety deficiencies
metro_stories.text: Deccan Herald reported on 15 October that the Pink Line faces 36 safety and technical deficiencies. Metro Rail News says BMRCL received CMRS observations on 9 October and planned to submit its compliance report on 13 October. The Hindu reports BMRCL will respond next week.

metro_stories.headline: Pink Line launch targeted for March 2027
metro_stories.text: Urban Acres reports the Pink Line targets a March 2027 launch despite delays, and says it nears launch after the safety review. The Daily Jagran reports BMTC will launch five new feeder services on the line.

metro_stories.headline: BMRCL starts soil testing on Sarjapur Road
metro_stories.text: BMRCL has begun soil testing on Sarjapur Road for the proposed Namma Metro Red Line corridor, reports The Hindu. Deccan Herald earlier reported BMRCL floated about Rs 6.86 crore of tenders for geotechnical investigations in four packages for Sarjapur–Hebbal Phase 3A.

metro_stories.headline: Purple Line halted after track intrusion
metro_stories.text: Urban Acres reports Namma Metro's Purple Line was halted after a track intrusion.

metro_stories.headline: K-RIDE to appoint suburban rail design consultant
metro_stories.text: Metro Rail Today reports K-RIDE will appoint a Detailed Design Consultant for the Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project. The Financial Express reports a double-decker viaduct and new bridges are planned across 3 corridors.

metro_stories.headline: Metro network eyed at 400 km by 2037
metro_stories.text: Bengaluru plans to expand its metro network to 400 km by 2037, YourStory reports, quoting Krishna Byre Gowda.

second.headline: Karnataka cancels eight Bengaluru flyover tenders

paragraphs.text: The Karnataka government has cancelled tenders for eight Bengaluru flyover projects, reports The Indian Express, which headlines the move as a response to flawed clauses and financial risks.
Urban Acres also reports that tenders for eight flyover projects were cancelled across the city.

watch.why: BMRCL is due to respond to the safety inspection observations, which shapes the line's opening timetable.
The 60-day window for suggestions and objections is open, though maps were reported unavailable online.
Apartment owners are awaiting assent to the new law on ownership and common areas.
The GBA has only directed a DPR for junctions; works depend on its preparation.
BDA applications close on 31 October noon after the extension.
